summary: Inland Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a regular quarterly distribution of $0.135600 per share, payable July 7, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. The distribution may be paid in cash or reinvested under the company's distribution reinvestment plan. No special situation—merely a routine dividend declaration. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return (beyond normal dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. It is an ordinary current report on Form 8-K under Item 8.01.
